messages:
alex: Quick summary from the ctx-length sweep I ran this morning across regions/hardware. kept it focused: Llama-2-70B (rope), Mistral-7B (GQA-default), Qwen-14B (GQA-hybrid).

alex: Configs: float16 baseline for Llama/Mistral, Qwen run both f16 and quant4a. seq lens: 1k, 4k, 8k, 16k, 32k. batches sized to keep p99 latency under 300ms target where possible.

priya: Nice. Which kernels did you force?

alex: On EU-H100 I used the default kernel picker. On NA-A100 I forced the older attention kernel for a comparison (kernel_id=att_v2). Observations below.

liam: Curious about non-linearity at >8k — any memory fragmentation or KV cache jumps?

alex: Yes — for Llama-2-70B we saw expected superlinear mem growth past 16k on a100 due to BKCL fallback; throughput collapsed ~2.8x compared to h100 at 32k. Mistral stayed much steadier (GQA path) until 32k but latency rose linearly. Qwen had the weird bit: f16 path on a100 hit a kernel fallback at 12k causing a step increase in p99. quant4a on Qwen avoided that fallback but quality dropped ~1.6 ROUGE on the eval set.

anya: Do you have the raw numbers? even ballpark is helpful.

alex: Paste of condensed table (throughput tokens/s per GPU):
```
model,hw,1k,4k,8k,16k,32k
Llama-70B,EU-H100,125k,118k,95k,62k,22k
Llama-70B,NA-A100,120k,110k,70k,25k,8k
Mistral-7B,EU-H100,210k,200k,175k,140k,95k
Mistral-7B,NA-A100,205k,195k,160k,135k,98k
Qwen-14B-f16,EU-H100,160k,150k,135k,80k,30k
Qwen-14B-f16,NA-A100,155k,130k,90k,40k,12k  <-- kernel fallback at 12k
Qwen-14B-quant4a,NA-A100,140k,130k,115k,90k,60k
```

priya: Those deltas are pretty big for Llama on a100 at 16k+. Sounds like kernel compatibility fragile. Did perf-bot capture traces?

perf-bot: trace uploaded: https://internal.redwood/perf/traces/1954309876/ctx-sweep (contains kernel_id, gpu-mem, alloc map). :white_check_mark:

liam: Thanks. The alloc map should show fragmentation spikes. Also we should verify if our kernel selector is accidentally preferring an attention implementation that uses extra temp buffers on a100.

alex: Agreed. I reran a short bisect on a100: forcing kernel_id=att_new avoids the big fallback but increases p99 by ~12% at 8k (so it's a tradeoff). For Qwen quant4a, quant path avoids the fallback entirely and is more stable across lens, so quant looks attractive for long-context production, but we must validate quality.

anya: What about cost/capacity sizing implications? If Llama drops to 8k tokens/s at 32k, we need ~3x more GPUs vs Mistral for same throughput. That matters for Dedicated reservations.

alex: Yep. Quick note on guidance to ops: prefer GQA models for >16k unless customer requires Llama; fallback policy should route Llama longseq to H100 pools only. We should also add a kernel-fallback telemetry alert when p99 jumps >50% on rollout.

infra-bot: created ticket INF-1129 "kernel fallback alert: p99 step on long context" assigned to @liam.

priya: Can you drop the exact commands you used to run the sweep? will reproduce.

alex: Command (simplified):
```
./run_sweep.sh --models llama-70b,mistral-7b,qwen-14b --seq-lens 1024,4096,8192,16384,32768 --regions eu,na --gpus h100,a100 --quant qwen:4a --batch-policy dynamic
```

alex: Raw eval diff for Qwen quant4a vs f16 on our 500-sample long-context eval set: avg ROUGE-1 delta -1.6, BLEU -0.9, hallucination-rate +0.4%. Worth running a deeper quality-only pass before recommending quant by default.

liam: Next actions: 1) liam to triage kernel selector on a100 and try att_new autotune 2) alex to run 2k-sample quality eval for qwen-quant4a 3) priya to update capacity note in the docs.

anya: Thanks — this is super actionable. :thumbsup:

alex: Will post the full upload (CSV + charts) to the perf board later today: https://internal.redwood/perf/boards/ctx-sweep-1954309876

anya: ack
